footer.description: Helping you take a confident next step in choosing a profession and a place to study.
footer.sourceNote: Catalogue data is imported from the team's working spreadsheet and shown unchanged.

common.errorText: Check the database connection and try again.
common.emptyText: Change the search terms or reset the filters.
common.contentLanguageNotice: Catalogue content is available in Russian only for now — it is shown in the original language.

home.title: Find your next path
home.description: Take a short test, explore the directions, professions and universities that fit you — and build your own plan.
home.journeyThree: Find a profession and a university
home.cardDirectionsText: From IT and medicine to law and science.
home.cardProfessionsText: Compare skills, school subjects and demand.
home.cardUniversitiesText: Connect a profession to programs and universities.

test.title: Career orientation test
test.intro: Answer {count} questions and the test will show the directions that may suit you. No sign-up required.
test.emptyText: The test is imported from the team's spreadsheet with pnpm db:import:sheet.

results.title: Your result
results.subtitle: The test suggests directions that may suit you. It is not a final verdict — keep exploring the other directions too.
results.emptyText: Take the test — the result is stored in this browser.
results.howText: Every answer is tied to a profile from the source test sheet, and each profile is mapped to catalogue directions. The percentage is the share of points collected out of the maximum possible for that direction.

directions.title: Directions
directions.subtitle: The professional fields in the catalogue. Each one holds professions, skills and universities.
directions.emptyText: Run the catalogue import: pnpm db:import:sheet.
directions.noProfessions: This direction has no professions yet.
directions.noUniversities: There are no programs for this direction in the catalogue yet.

professions.title: Professions
professions.subtitle: What they do, which skills they need and where to study for them.
professions.sortMatchHint: Sorting by match becomes available once you have taken the test.
professions.salaryUnknown: The source does not give a figure — it records a pay level instead.
professions.universitiesTitle: Where to study for this profession
professions.noPrograms: The catalogue has no programs linked to this profession yet.

universities.title: Universities
universities.subtitle: Programs, admission requirements and contacts, as recorded in the team's spreadsheet.
universities.filterTuitionHint: The tuition filter applies to universities whose cost is recorded in tenge.
universities.sortTuitionHint: Sorting by tuition groups universities by the source currency: amounts in different currencies are never converted.
universities.ratingHint: Shown exactly as the source records it.
universities.reviewsEmpty: No reviews yet. We do not publish reviews that are not in the source.
universities.noPrograms: Programs for this university have not been loaded yet.
universities.admissionEmpty: The source does not record admission requirements for this university.

favorites.title: Favourites
favorites.subtitle: Saved items live in this browser only.
favorites.emptyText: Add professions, universities and directions — they will show up here.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Searches directions, professions, universities and programs.
search.emptyText: Try another query — for example “design” or “NU”.
search.hintText: For example: medicine, Data Analyst, Almaty.

careerPath.title: Career path
careerPath.subtitle: The route from a direction to admission, built from catalogue data.
careerPath.chooseHint: Open a profession and press “Build the path” to see the route here.
careerPath.emptyText: Take the test or pick a profession in the catalogue.
careerPath.ladderEmpty: The source does not describe a career ladder for this profession.

admissionPlan.title: Admission plan
admissionPlan.subtitle: Steps worth taking. Your ticks are stored in this browser.
admissionPlan.stepSubjects: Work out your school subjects and exams
admissionPlan.noUniversities: Add universities to favourites and their requirements will appear here.

grants.title: Grants
grants.subtitle: Grant information is shown exactly as the source records it for each university.
grants.emptyText: The source records no grants for any university.
grants.note: We do not add amounts or dates that are missing from the source. Always check the university's own website.

about.title: About the project
about.subtitle: Next Path is a navigator for school students choosing a profession and a university.
about.problemText: Information about professions, universities, requirements and grants is scattered across dozens of sites. Next Path puts it into one route: test → direction → profession → university → admission plan.
about.dataText: The catalogue is imported from the team's working spreadsheet and shown unchanged. When the source has no ranking, tuition or deadline, we hide the block instead of inventing one.
about.languageText: The interface is translated into Russian, Kazakh and English. Catalogue content exists in Russian only for now and is shown in the original language.
about.privacyText: No sign-up is needed. Your test result and favourites stay in your browser.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This page does not seem to exist. Start from the home page or open the directions catalogue.
